s1.desc: a wide snowy field under a pale sky with soft white clouds

spans.view: with low snowy hills on the horizon behind her

beats.text: Polly sits alone in the snow, both flippers raised in front of her, looking down at {ifin}
Polly sits still with the phone in her flippers, waiting, her beak settling into a small frown

spans.notes: compare f0/f49: horizon and snow drifts overlap exactly, camera locked. The phone is the iFin (pale grey back, three lenses, tuft on top). A thin dark line runs down the left edge of every frame of this skit (export border, not an overlay). Polly is small (~17% of the height).
time-lapse: day/night cross-dissolves (luma ramps from f50), snow piles up on Polly, and pine trees and bushes sprout and grow around her
time-lapse continues at night and day while the trees close over Polly, with a push-in into the branches; she is buried by ~f190 and only snowy trees remain
